Characterization_methods: in situ heating experiments in TEM mode
Proof in the paper: The characterization of the RuIr nanocrystals was performed using various methods including XRD, XPS, SEM, TEM, STEM, and elemental mapping. The atomic-step enriched nature of the nanocrystals was revealed through these techniques, and the specific crystal plane indices were determined using HAADF STEM and in situ heating experiments in TEM mode.
